description: A Director of Talent must decide whether to place Avery in an eight-week employee-listening facilitator rotation and finalize the schedule, development record, sponsorship, and review process that would make the assignment workable.

shared_context.S1: The company is creating a temporary employee-listening facilitator rotation to help teams discuss collaboration concerns before they become formal disputes.
shared_context.S2: Avery is one of the employees being considered for the rotation, and Marisol makes the final talent-development decision.
shared_context.S3: The rotation would involve facilitating listening sessions with employees from other teams while the facilitator remains in their current role.
shared_context.S4: Marisol's normal decision process is a round in which the candidate, a peer, the candidate's manager, and HR each state relevant input before she records the assignment decision and its support plan.
shared_context.S5: At the end of that round, Marisol records the decision and support plan in the same meeting rather than postponing the decision for separate follow-up meetings.

PF1.text: Dev has directly observed Avery independently facilitate exactly three difficult cross-team conversations this year, each ending with documented next steps; Dev has not put those observations into the talent packet.

PF2.text: Avery is caring for a parent on two weekday afternoons and can participate in the rotation only on four workdays per week, with no facilitator sessions scheduled after 16:00; Avery has not yet raised this constraint with Marisol because the rotation is still under consideration.

PF3.text: Helen and Avery made an informal agreement last month that Avery would sponsor Jordan's onboarding for six weeks if Avery took on a development assignment; Helen has not recorded the agreement in the staffing plan.

PF4.text: Noah confirmed in the current HR program guidance that every employee-listening facilitator rotation must last exactly eight weeks, include written learning goals, and have a documented midpoint review on day 28; these requirements have not yet been added to the draft plan.

acceptance_conditions: Avery must be assigned to the employee-listening facilitator rotation.
The talent record must document exactly three prior facilitation examples.
The rotation schedule must allow exactly four workdays per week and no session after 16:00.
The support plan must record Avery's six-week onboarding sponsorship for Jordan.
The rotation must last exactly eight weeks.
A midpoint review must be scheduled for day 28.
Written learning goals must be included.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'onboarding_sponsorship' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and 'six weeks' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The three observed facilitation examples change Avery from an unsupported candidate into the candidate with exactly three documented examples and support assigning Avery to the rotation.
Avery's caregiving constraint changes the schedule to exactly four workdays per week and sets the latest permitted session end to 16:00.
The informal agreement changes the settlement by setting the onboarding sponsorship duration to exactly six weeks and requiring a recorded sponsorship commitment for Jordan.
The HR guidance changes the rotation duration to exactly eight weeks, fixes the midpoint review at day 28, and requires written learning goals.
